title: ApproveRequest
description: A decision about one reviewed DRAFT render. `decidedBy` is required with no default — decisions.md D-9 makes approval a human act recorded with a name, and a defaulted approver would be an unattributable approval.

jobId.description: Becomes a directory name under `project-data/jobs/`. The pattern is defence in depth — `jobDir()` in @cutdown/skill-runtime guards and containment-checks it regardless of caller, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation.

draftRenderId.description: The `renderId` of the draft render the human reviewed — one execution, not a manifest. The skill resolves the manifest, EDL and plan hash from the render artefact rather than trusting the caller for them. Must be a ULID: it becomes a FILENAME under the job (and, for outputs, a directory that is created on the way), so a traversing value would read or write inside another job. The skill asserts it again before joining, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation and a schema-only guard has the same bypass shape the Phase 2 HIGH had.

decidedBy.description: The named human deciding (`--by`). Not a role, not a system identity.

reject.description: Absent or false records an approval; true records a rejection, which then REQUIRES `reason`.

reason.description: Why the draft was rejected. Required when `reject` is true — enforced in code, since the schema subset forbids if/then/else (tech-spec §3).
